# discover_hugo_site

Usage: discover public pages and entry points.

Endpoint: `https://mcp.arleo.eu/mcp`

Inputs:
- none

Outputs:
- site metadata
- canonical URLs

Security:
- read-only
- no auth
- no writes

Limitations:
- public pages only
- no filesystem paths
